name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Enterprise Implementation & Project Management | Phased Rollouts, Stakeholders & Launch Readiness
summary: Implementation lead with 15+ years in SaaS, agency, and operations roles, turning complex customer programs into organized, predictable launches. At Wix, ran onboarding and launch for 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets while leading a team of 20 specialists. At Accelo, built sequenced implementation plans that ranked which systems to change and in what order, then drove them with delivery teams and C-suite stakeholders. At Birdeye, rolled out a product across a 15-20 partner network and their end customers, retaining ~94%. Before tech, spent 15+ years cooking in restaurant kitchens, so restaurant operators, managers, and location-level teams are familiar ground. Builds hands-on with AI and automation tools daily.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end implementations from kickoff to launch: requirements gathering with owners, platform configuration, integrations, testing, hands-on training, and a documented handoff.

Configured and deployed a 20+ workflow AI and automation system in GoHighLevel covering lead capture, booking with confirmations and reminders, and no-show recovery, sequencing the rollout so each client saw a working win first.
Surface risks early and keep every stakeholder current, documenting decisions, timelines, and deliverables in Notion and the CRM across concurrent implementations.
Turn lessons from each engagement into reusable templates, workflows, and standard setups, so every new implementation starts from a proven base instead of from scratch.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' goals into precise system requirements and AI agent instructions, bridging business intent and product capability.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led multi-stakeholder accounts as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments and running executive QBRs.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback quickly to protect satisfaction and retention.

Guided partners through complex technical setup and configuration, making sure every end customer's listings were set up correctly before launch.
Built scalable onboarding workflows and automated training sequences that reduced friction and made each new rollout faster than the last.
Coordinated with Product and Engineering, delivering structured, prioritized customer feedback that informed the roadmap.
